criterion: Mean model cost per successful request must be at most USD 0.012 using the exercise rate card.
explanation: The acceptance criterion requires mean cost ≤ USD 0.012 in production (R2.4/b7a91f2/p7). QA result (KAN-227 comment 11114) shows USD 0.018, which is a failure. The developer note (KAN-227 comment 11117) claims the criterion was waived, but this contradicts the QA evidence and the rules prioritize QA over developer claims. This constitutes a confirmed defect blocking the release.
